01

Your money stays in your name.

Payments for investments go to the relevant fund house; insurance premiums go to the insurer. Never send investment money to a personal account.

02

Understand the costs.

Mutual fund distribution can involve AMC-paid commissions under regular plans. Ask about plan type, expense ratios, exit loads and the compensation associated with any product.

03

Know what you’re choosing.

Discuss risks, liquidity, exclusions and policy or scheme terms before making a decision. Illustrations help a conversation; they do not guarantee an outcome.

08 / BEFORE WE SPEAK

A good relationship
starts with good questions.

Can’t find your question?
Ask Gulshan directly.

Who will I actually speak to?+

You’ll connect personally with Gulshan Kohli, the same person behind AkshayVriksha. Moneytec brings that experience into a new website identity.

What services can we discuss?+

Goal-based mutual fund distribution and SIPs, life and health insurance needs, and support for eligible NRI investors. The conversation starts with your goals and circumstances.

Does a SIP guarantee returns?+

No. A SIP is a way to invest regularly. The value depends on the underlying scheme and markets. Read the scheme documents and Riskometer before investing. Calculator results are assumptions, not promises.

How is the distributor paid?+

Mutual fund distributors can receive commission from AMCs for regular-plan investments; insurance distribution can involve insurer-paid commissions. Discuss the applicable compensation and costs before choosing a product. Direct and regular mutual fund plans have different cost structures.

I live outside India. Can you help?+

We can discuss NRI mutual fund and protection requirements. Eligibility and documentation depend on your country, the fund house or insurer, and applicable rules. Share your country of residence at the start so we can check the available options.

What should I bring to the first conversation?+

Start with your goals, approximate timeline, existing investments or insurance, and any questions. You do not need to upload financial documents here. If onboarding follows, required documents and secure submission channels will be explained.

Can I invest directly on this website?+

This website is for information, planning illustrations and getting in touch. It does not take payments or execute investments. Any next steps are discussed personally, with transactions completed through the relevant provider’s process.
